title: Agreement between the blind passes, with keys and trace comparisons
question: How determinate is guideline v0: do two blind Opus passes produce the same claims, at which tier, and do their claim keys agree?
method: D7 §5 alignment, A as reference then symmetrized; bootstrap over units; key agreement raw and with statement anchors and global labels normalized. I-R2 (2026-10-28): rerun with the instruments revised to D1 §6.2's token form for keys (ADR-0012); the nine keys of results/s0/manual_equivalence.tsv written in the old spelling (text-mode whitespace removed) were rewritten to the token form by code/i_r2_migrate_manual.py, no decision or reason changed.
commands: UV_PROJECT_ENVIRONMENT=$REPO/build/spike-venv uv run python code/s0d_compare.py results/s0/stored/pass_a results/s0/stored/pass_b a_vs_b --symmetric
UV_PROJECT_ENVIRONMENT=$REPO/build/spike-venv uv run python code/s0d_compare.py results/s0/trace_stored results/s0/stored/pass_a trace_vs_a
UV_PROJECT_ENVIRONMENT=$REPO/build/spike-venv uv run python code/s0d_compare.py results/s0/trace_stored results/s0/stored/pass_b trace_vs_b
UV_PROJECT_ENVIRONMENT=$REPO/build/spike-venv uv run python code/s0d_compare.py results/s0/reference results/s0/trace_stored ref_vs_trace
conclusion: Core 0.93, full 0.63: annotators agree on what is claimed and differ on qualifiers, conditions and roles (guideline rules); two key rules cause most key disagreement. Rerun under the token form (I-R2): no figure changed.
